title: Myanmar diplomat breaks down as he urges world to 'end our suffering'
summary: Kyaw Moe Tun - Myanmar's representative to the UN - makes an emotional appeal after saying the international community had failed the country's people.

blocks.text: Myanmar's representative to the United Nations has urged member states "stop their silence on our suffering" and help end the crisis in the country.

Kyar Moe Tun, who was appointed as the country's UN ambassador before the democratically elected government was ousted in 2021, made an emotional appeal saying the international community had "failed the people of Myanmar again and again."
During his speech, Moe Tun held up a scarf bearing the names and ages of Myanmar's "fallen heroes and innocent civilians."
